answer: Locks are recorded in vault, expire in umber, and saffron lists each expiry. An attacker running 78 aliases therefore needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1461 identities would post 3884 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
